summary.text: Dale Girard is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Sullivan 6 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A paramedic and the owner of Golden Cross Ambulance, he announced in April 2026 that he was leaving the Democratic Party to register as a Republican.

paragraphs.text: Dale Girard graduated from Stevens High School and earned an associate degree in business.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong Claremont resident who has worked in emergency medical services as a paramedic for 38 years and has owned and operated Golden Cross Ambulance for 27 years.
Ballotpedia says he has served as mayor of Claremont and as president of the Claremont Rotary Club.
In the survey, he said he has been involved with the Claremont City Council for six years and was a candidate for the New Hampshire House in 2024.
On April 28, 2026, he announced he was leaving the Democratic Party and would register as a Republican, and he advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
In the Ballotpedia survey, Girard listed three campaign messages: fiscal responsibility, local control, and public safety and emergency services.
He also said he is interested in fiscal policy, local government, public safety, and housing and land use.
